text:
carmen: Heads-up: labeler queue spiked ~3x for the q4b-int4 onboarding set, lots of disagreement on the longform prompts. anyone else seeing fingerprint collisions?
ben: saw the same. margin of duplicate detection jumped. I think fuzzyhash similarity threshold is letting close paraphrases through.
alice: yep, collision rate up around 6% on the new samplebank vs baseline. I traced a few — same core prompt but small punctuation/markdown diffs.
dave: can you paste an example?
alice: sure — two samples: `User: summarize the RFC` vs `User: summarize the RFC.` only diff is trailing period, but tokenizer->hash pipeline gives different fingerprints.
carmen: Oof. That'll blow up labeler throughput — they treat them as different and get conflicting labels. we need a quick mitigation.
ben: quick mitigation: lower dedupe similarity threshold for now and requeue near-duplicates to a rapid-review flow. also mark them as "micro-duplicates" so goldset doesn't pick both.
ops-tim: I can push a hotfix to the sampler; new config: `FUZZY_SIM=0.87` -> `0.90`? want conservative or aggressive?
dave: raise to 0.92. We want to dedupe more aggressively for onboarding holdouts. but keep a flag so we can undo if it affects recall.
alice: agree. also add a canonicalization step before hashing: normalize trailing punctuation, collapse whitespace, strip markdown code fences for user text. small script: 
```
def canonical(s):
    s = s.strip().replace('\\n',' ')
    s = re.sub(r"\\s+", ' ', s)
    s = s.rstrip('.!')
    s = strip_markdown_code(s)
    return s
```

labeler-bot: FYI: relabel batch 3245 paused (reason: duplicate surge).
carmen: good catch. ben, can you run a small rehash on the paused batch and tag micro-duplicates? if >70% near-dup cluster, collapse to one exemplar.
ben: on it. will run a sampling job `scripts/rehash_and_cluster.py --batch 3245 --thresh 0.92` and share counts.
ops-tim: deployed FUZZY_SIM=0.92 to staging sampler. will promote in 10m if no regressions.
dave: aside: we saw annotator disagreement spikes when we switched to int4 quant candidate QX2B — could be output style shifts making prompts ambiguous. can eng-ml run a quick calibration eval vs baseline to surface which prompt types flip labels?
carmen: yes — let's do a lightweight eval: pick 1k holdout prompts, run both baseline and int4 on rerank/generation, compute label drift heatmap (intent/answer match).
alice: I can assemble the 1k stratified by longform/short/markdown/code. will push to shared bucket.
ben: after clustering rehash, I'll exclude micro-duplicates from that 1k sample so we don't conflate dedupe noise with model-induced drift.
ops-tim: promoted change to prod sampler. monitor enabled. rolling back if false positives >1%.
labeler-bot: automated note: 412 items collapsed into 79 clusters in batch 3245 after rehash.
carmen: great. next steps: 1) run the 1k drift eval (alice + dave), 2) surface top 50 high-disagreement prompts to golden-review channel, 3) temporary annotator rota change to focus on clusters. I'll coordinate with Label Ops.
dave: I'll prep the eval harness and share results by EOD. if we see quality regression >5% on longform, we'll prioritize expanding golden set.
ben: ping me if you want me to re-seed microgoldens from the 79 clusters.
carmen: thanks all — huge improvement response time. will update label-ops and close loop once eval lands. :thumbsup:
